pages.text: Ions leak through a membrane's channels until the voltage across it holds them back: the Nernst potential E = (RT/zF) ln(c_out/c_in), about 26.7/z mV per e-fold at body heat. Potassium sets a resting cell near −90 mV; sodium pulls toward +60.
$(thing)Set$(): Outside, Inside.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Leaky seal: the voltage varies by ±2%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): The membrane bursts (osmosis).$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): Richer solutions are faster.
